tools.name: list_covered_cities
tools.description: List tracked city slugs, rent sample counts, observation dates, and source links.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Read asking rent statistics and bedroom breakdowns for a tracked city.

tools.name: get_national_summary
tools.description: Read the tracked national rent sample. Optionally compare one state with the national sample.

tools.name: search_apartments
tools.description: Find last-verified apartment listings. Supply a city, state, ZIP, or property name. A neighborhood requires its city. min_rent must not exceed max_rent. Multiple building names may match; use returned IDs. Results include asking rents, verification dates, and source links.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Read one building and its last-known unit prices, fees, concessions, and verification date. Respect no_current_availability.

tools.name: get_rent_history
tools.description: Read daily asking rent history for either a city or a property. Supply exactly one of city or property_id. Changes in the tracked sample can affect market trends.

tools.name: get_price_cuts
tools.description: Read observed asking rent reductions over the last seven days in one tracked city. These observations do not guarantee current availability.

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Read your account plan, data-use license, shared data call allowance, usage, and UTC reset date. Check commercial_use_allowed when the user states a commercial purpose. This tool does not consume the data allowance.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the stable identity of this authenticated Average Rent account.
